description: This header file declares utility functions for network-related operations, such as conversions between MAC/IP addresses and strings, and retrieving network interface information, within the beerocks::bpl::utils namespace.

methods.name: mac_to_string
methods.description: Converts a MAC address from a byte array to its string representation.

methods.name: mac_from_string
methods.description: Parses a MAC address string into a byte array.

methods.name: ipv4_to_string
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address from a uint32_t or byte array to its string representation.

methods.name: ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into a byte array.

methods.name: uint_ipv4_from_string
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address string directly into a uint32_t representation.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_get_ip
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: linux_iface_to_index
methods.description: Converts a network interface name to its corresponding index.
